title: Washing away germs
examples: Do germs really make us sick?
How long should I wash my hands for?
What is the best soap to use?

explain.say: Germs are tiny living things. They are too small to see.
Germs can be on things you touch, like door handles and toys.
Soap helps lift germs off your hands. Then water washes them away.

draw.text: Soap traps and washes away germs.

explain.say: Wash your hands for twenty seconds. That is about two Happy Birthday songs.
When you wash your hands, scrub between your fingers too.
Always wash your hands before you eat.

items: Before eating | Germs are on hands

faq.q: Why do we need to wash our hands?
faq.a: We wash our hands to take away tiny germs that can make us sick.
asks: Why do we wash our hands?
What is the purpose of hand washing?
How do I get rid of germs?

faq.q: How long should I wash my hands for?
faq.a: Scrub your hands for about twenty seconds. That is about as long as singing Happy Birthday twice.
asks: How long should I wash my hands for?
What is the correct time for hand washing?

faq.q: Is soap important for washing germs?
faq.a: Yes. Soap helps lift the germs off your skin. Then the water washes the soap and the germs away.
asks: Is soap important for washing germs?

faq.q: Can I just rinse with water?
faq.a: Water alone leaves many germs behind. Use soap and water to clean properly.
asks: Can I just rinse with water?
Is water enough to clean hands?

faq.q: When should I wash my hands?
faq.a: Wash your hands before eating and after using the toilet. Wash them after playing outside too.
asks: When should I wash my hands?
When is it best to wash hands?
After what activities should I wash?

facts: Germs are too small to be seen with the naked eye.
Soap helps lift and trap germs so water can wash them away.
Washing hands for twenty seconds is the recommended time.
You should wash hands before eating and after using the toilet.

quiz.say: Why do you use soap when you wash your hands?

options.show: it lifts germs off your hands
options.say: it lifts germs off your hands

options.show: it makes your hands smell nice
options.say: it makes your hands smell nice

quiz.why: Soap lifts germs off your skin. Then water washes them away.

wrong.1: Some soap smells nice, but its job is to lift off germs.
wrong.2: The tap makes the water warm, and soap lifts off germs.

quiz.say: Sam rinses his hands with water only. What happens to most germs?
quiz.why: Water alone leaves many germs behind. Soap helps lift them off.

wrong.0: Water alone leaves many germs behind, so use soap too.
wrong.2: Germs can stay on dry hands, so soap is needed.

quiz.say: Which order is right for washing your hands?
quiz.why: Wet your hands, add soap and scrub. Then rinse and dry them.

wrong.0: You need water first, so the soap can make bubbles.
wrong.1: Drying comes last, after you rinse.
